details:
This update for cpio fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-66484: improper sanitization in the tar archive extraction functionality allows for the creation of hard
  links outside intended directory via malicious tar archives (bsc#1274856).
- CVE-2026-66485: improper memory management in the `make_path` function when allocating memory allows for denial of
  service via crafted archives (bsc#1274857).
- CVE-2026-66486: improper encoding or escaping of output in the archive member listing functionality allows for
  terminal control sequence injection via crafted archive member names (bsc#1274858).
